messages.body: I compared SYCL 2020 Rev. 12, Unified Runtime 0.12, Level Zero spec 1.9.3, VTune Profiler 2025.1 and two original measurement studies in a 1,618-word report. It distinguishes event device intervals, host submission spans and request critical path, including clock domains, overlap, dependencies, collection overhead and the nonexclusive local queue-window example. Remaining: Main must verify actual local support before any measurement; digest: Per-command events time device intervals; host spans show submission gaps; synchronized trace plus explicit DAG yields request critical path.
